notes: Yeoman generator; the weakness is in the generated app template, which logs a user-supplied email from a public API. Fix stops logging the value.
Parsing date strings is moment's documented job. Unbounded regex quantifiers capped at 256.

Range strings usually come from developers or package metadata; the docs do not present them as untrusted input. Whitespace is collapsed before matching and a safe regex set is used. Contested call: ReDoS only matters if an app passes user-supplied ranges.
Fix only adds a docs note: never replace controller or action files with untrusted code. The maintainer places the risk on the app, which counts as visible pushback.
The pretty option is a developer setting; the advisory itself says the risk needs attacker control of compiler options. Fix rejects non-whitespace values and escapes the indent string.
adapter-node now enforces BODY_SIZE_LIMIT on streamed bodies even without a valid content-length.

Race condition from a global platform injector shared across concurrent SSR requests. Fix passes a per-request bootstrap context; changed test file is a helper, not a race test. Rechecked under v1.2 tie-break: not boundary changed to network.
qs.parse is meant for query strings from requests. Fixes a bypass of the existing prototype key check.
Satori renders caller-supplied JSX and style values into SVG, often user text for images. Fix escapes attribute and text output via buildXMLString and rejects invalid style properties.
Self-hosted video platform; client upload preview.
Backstage scaffolder plugin module.
Trigger.dev webapp.
Keys and messages from other parties are what OpenPGP.js processes. Unknown and GNU s2k types now throw instead of falling through.
The iface argument names a network interface and is set by the developer; the advisory says the attacker must control it. Fix commit was not fetchable, so the fix type could not be checked.
Happy DOM runs scripts in documents the caller loads. JavaScript evaluation is now off by default, and the server renderer adds --disallow-code-generation-from-strings.
Route patterns are written by the developer. The generated regex no longer backtracks; the added test checks the regex for '/:a-:b'.
The advisory covers the Vrite CMS backend, not the SDK's own code.
Gossipsub messages come from peers. StrictSign now requires the message key to derive to the claimed from peer ID.
Mermaid renders diagram text that apps often take from users, and it ships a securityLevel setting for untrusted diagrams. The fix caps radar ticks; a spec test covers it.
Prototype pollution through object state keyed by className. Whether className comes from app code or server responses is not clear from the advisory. The state map now uses Object.create(null).
grunt.file.copy followed a symlink at the destination. The fix unlinks a destination symlink instead of writing through it.

networkStats(iface) takes an interface name set by the developer. The library already sanitizes it, which suggests it expects bad values; under the current rule this is still caller code. The fix keeps the name to one path segment.
Recipient addresses often come from users. The address parser no longer joins atoms across a comment, and a recipient limit is added.
NocoBase application plugin.
Parsing untrusted XML is xmldom's job. Attribute de-duplication now uses an index, so the cost is linear.
Property paths are usually written by developers, for example in yup schemas. The setter now ignores paths containing __proto__, constructor or prototype; test.js checks each.
Volto (Plone) add-on.
Protestware: the maintainer added an infinite loop on purpose. No input is involved. The linked fix only changes package.json.
Enforcement logic bug: an empty allowedDomains list did not block network access. The fix applies network restriction whenever network config is present.
The HTML entity escaping helper is meant for display data. Arrays are now joined into a string before escaping.
The clean-html sanitizer exists to clean untrusted editor content. It now removes HTML smuggled inside MathML or SVG.
Build tool put all environment variables into published browser bundles. No attacker input; now only DEBUG and NODE_ENV are injected.
Mockoon is a developer mock server. Request data in a templated filePath could escape the served directory; a real containment check replaces the prefix check.

OPC UA server SDK. Authorization failed open when no RolePermissions were declared. The fix adds an opt-in deny policy and keeps allow as the default. Rechecked under v1.2 tie-break: not boundary changed to network.
Nuxt dev server exposed a component test route. The route now only exists in test mode, and the path is also checked against the project root.
The xDS route and RBAC matcher compares request paths against a configured regex. Wrapping the pattern in a group stops alternation from matching partially.

Share paths and file names passed to client methods are data the library handles, and apps often take them from users. Contested call between end-user via caller and caller code. exec with string quoting replaced by execa with argument arrays.

Permission-check attribution bug: HID and USB checks from iframes were given the top frame's origin. Authorization logic, so not a boundary question. Rechecked under v1.2 tie-break: not boundary changed to network.
The NSIS installer ran cmd without a full path, so the search path on the target machine decided what ran. Now uses the full System32 path.
Code generator; servers[].url from the OpenAPI spec ended up unescaped in generated code. Specs are often third-party files. Values are now escaped.
URL validation helper that apps use on URLs from many sources. ReDoS-prone regex rewritten.
Handlebars treats templates and pre-parsed ASTs as trusted developer input; the attack needs control of the template. The compiler now validates AST node values and checks decorators.
MathJax renders TeX found in page content, often user comments. \unicode now requires a numeric argument, and MathML attribute values are quoted.
Running untrusted code is isolated-vm's purpose. Unsafe reference behavior now needs an explicit unsafeInherit option, and proxies and getters throw.
Backstage backend logger missed secrets with surrounding whitespace, leaking GitLab tokens. Redaction strings are now trimmed.
The /_image endpoint on the Cloudflare adapter accepted data: URLs. data: is no longer allowed unless matched by remote patterns.
Sanitizing untrusted HTML is the library's job. URI scheme checks now apply to action, formaction, data, poster, background and other URL attributes; tests added.
Streaming large or untrusted JSON is the library's purpose; the new option is documented as a guard for untrusted input. Filters now throw past maxDepth (default 1024).
Defuddle extracts content from web page HTML the caller passes in. Site extractor output is now escaped and sanitized.
Prism highlights code shown on pages, often user-submitted snippets. Backtracking-prone grammar regexes rewritten.
Locally run MCP server; tool-call arguments arrive from the AI client. execSync with command strings replaced by execFileSync with argument arrays.
Source maps are often third-party or uploaded data. Section offsets are now validated and capped, and large line gaps are built in one step.
setIn paths are usually chosen by the developer. __proto__ and constructor.prototype path segments now throw.
The Android code logged the encryption key. No attacker input; the log now says only whether encryption is on.
esbuild's dev server answered any origin through permissive CORS. The fix drops the wildcard CORS header; the server file was beyond the digest limit, so this rests on the advisory and changelog.
Express middleware reading the X-HTTP-Method-Override request header. The regex split is replaced with indexOf and trim.
Key paths are usually set by the developer. Prototype pollution guard and argument checks added; tests updated.
NocoBase application plugin.
Database adapter race: concurrent requests could pass the rate-limit compare-and-swap on PostgreSQL. The guard is repeated on the UPDATE itself.
vm2 exists to run untrusted guest code. Buffers handed to the sandbox no longer share Node's pooled backing memory.
Markdown to HTML; the docs claimed safe defaults but raw HTML was allowed. Sanitizing is now on by default.
Code generator; the GraphQL schema usually comes from a remote endpoint through introspection, sometimes from a file. Comment-closing sequences from the schema are now escaped.
Code analysis tool; globs from the analyzed repository could reach the parent of the project root. Dot-wildcard segments are now constrained; only fuzz targets were added, no test.
Tokens to verify usually come from requests. Array-valued iss claims must now all be allowed.
Form validation runs on user input. The URL regex was rewritten to avoid backtracking.
CI tool; branch and ref names come from the CI environment and can be set by whoever opens a pull request. execSync strings replaced by execFileSync arrays.
Protestware: audio and video played for Russian-language visitors. The behavior was removed.
Parsing date strings is Luxon's job. The RFC 2822 comment-stripping regex no longer matches nested parentheses quadratically.
Vite dev server; fetchModule over the WebSocket skipped the server.fs check. fetchModule is now disabled for the client environment and the check enforced elsewhere.
ApostropheCMS module.
Untrusted sandbox code could crash the host through an unhandled host promise rejection. The bridge now marks host promises handled.
XML parsing; an unterminated stop-node body was rescanned repeatedly. Scans are now cached.
Recipient address parsing; a '>' inside a quoted local part ended the address early. The parser now tracks quotes, comments and literals.
Directory listing rendered file names from disk without escaping. The directory middleware was removed from connect and moved to serve-index.
Verifying signed XML such as SAML responses from other parties. Only references from the re-parsed SignedInfo are trusted, and empty SignedInfo is rejected.
Query builder; values bound as parameters come from end users. Escaping and identifier checks were tightened.
SSR renderer; the nonce comes from ssrContext set by the app. The nonce is now constrained before it goes into HTML attributes.
Fetching previews for user-supplied URLs is the job. IPv6 loopback, ULA, link-local and rebinding hostnames are now blocked, with a warning when DNS is not resolved.
Strapi admin plugin.
ReDoS in the raw-block lexer rule. Template source is author code per Handlebars docs. The greedy match became lazy.
ASAR integrity bypass by placing a non-ASAR app folder on disk. With the fuse on, search paths now load only from an ASAR archive.
Request path decoding differed between middleware matching and cache lookup. Decoding is now atomic and matching also tries the decoded path.
Vega specs and expressions are often from users, which is why the CSP interpreter exists. Passing a function where a scale name is expected is no longer allowed.
Solid SSR renderer; String.replace treated $ patterns in rendered data. Output is now escaped and spliced with slice.
Prototype pollution through an array path segment that skipped the __proto__ check. Keys are now coerced to strings first.
Old React server render put the root ID into an attribute unescaped. It is now escaped.
Datepicker *Text options are developer config, but the maintainers fixed it anyway. Option text now goes in with .text() instead of HTML.
X-Forwarded-For behind ALB; the first entry is client-controlled. The adapter now takes the last entry, which ALB appends.
A redirect from the remote server to another origin kept Authorization and Cookie. Header names are now matched case-insensitively when stripping.
Editor content from users; noscript content was entity-decoded on serialize. That filter was removed and noncontent regexes must match fully.
Brace patterns can come from users through glob libraries. A nesting depth limit was added; past it the rest is kept literal.
Code generator; the SQL injection is in the generated reactive repository code. findAllBy with Criteria was removed from the templates.
populate() match can carry query input from end users. The $where check now also covers nested and non-array match objects.
styleIncludePaths comes from the project config. execSync with a shell string became execFileSync with args.
Pollution through option paths in parsed .proto definitions. setProperty now refuses __proto__.
Plugin results were written to the Android log. Logging now goes through a configurable level, default ERROR.
A crafted remote repository could write outside the work tree. Index and tree entries with ../ are rejected.
Only affects code that passes untrusted strings as the replacement in .replace on named-group regexes. Helper regex fixed per the advisory; diff not fetchable here so the test field is left blank.

Dev server HMR websocket accepted any origin, so a web page could read source. Origin check added per the advisory; the PR head is a merge with master so the diff is too noisy to read and the test field is left blank.
Parsing JWTs from requests. Reserved header keys moved off the prototype, and parse no longer fills defaults.
Rate limit keyed per IPv6 address. IPs are now normalized and grouped by a configurable subnet.
Generic Perforce wrapper; run(command, args) is the caller's command line. exec with a string became spawn with args.
Clone takes a repository URL, often from app data. An option-looking URL could inject git flags. -- now separates options from the URL.
Cobbler provisioning server.
Airflow provider package.
Another local user could pre-create the fixed /tmp build dir. pip now uses a random temp build directory.
Parsing TAXII messages from remote peers. Content parsing no longer treats strings as URLs or file paths.
crop_and_resize boxes values; TF treats model code as trusted, so whether op arguments are untrusted is not clear. Bounds check per the advisory; diff not fetchable so the test field is blank.
Parsing untrusted Mach-O binaries is the job. Null check and ownership fix in the fat binary C API.
Vibe-Trading app server.
XMPP stanza parsing from remote peers. Per-stanza byte and element count limits added.
Component server let any attribute of a block be called by name over HTTP. Only functions marked _is_server_fn are callable now.
Basic Auth check in the websockets server compared passwords with ==. Now hmac.compare_digest.
Decoding untrusted TIFF images is the job. Row size and bits-per-pixel checks added before unpacking tiles.
LlamaIndex pack, a library on top of llama-index, not an app plugin. The agent ran LLM-written SQL from user questions. Fix was dropping the package to a stale branch, per the advisory.
A cloned repo's submodule path could go through a symlink and write outside. Symlinks in the checkout path are now rejected.
Web fetch tool converts fetched pages to Markdown. A conversion cost budget now rejects deeply nested HTML.
Op argument crash; like TensorFlow, unclear whether op inputs are meant to be untrusted. Type and shape checks added.
Workflow include imported an included recipe's tools.py without the autoload opt-in. The opt-in is now enforced, with other audit fixes.
Apache Superset.
Parsing untrusted PDFs; a Prev trailer loop hung the parser. Seen offsets are now tracked.
URLValidator and IP validators run on user form data. IPv4 octets with leading zeros are now rejected.
web_crawl checked only the first URL; a redirect from the remote server could reach internal hosts. Redirect targets are now checked too.
Calibre-Web.
Compiler codegen bug: bytestring compare used dirty bytes. Comparison codegen fixed, so not an input-handling issue in the tool itself.
JSONReader ingests documents, often user-supplied. Deeply nested JSON exhausted recursion; traversal reworked.
OpenStack Neutron.
Parsing SQL strings; the string-literal regexes had overlapping alternatives. Regex fixed.
Modoboa mail admin.
changedetection.io.
Telemetry leaked content into exception events with include_content=False. Only the exception type is recorded now.
xiaomusic.
Password passed on the command line shows in the process list. Fix adds --password-file, --password-fd and an env var; the CLI flag itself is still there.
URLs passed to requests can come from users. The netrc host lookup now uses the parsed hostname instead of splitting netloc.
Scanning untrusted pickle files is the job. More modules and functions added to the blocklist.
ORM filter values come from end users. MySQL contains and like filters now escape values.
Plone CMS component.
Local race between creating a key file and chmod. The file is now created with 0600 directly.
redirect() and header values often carry user data. CR, LF and NUL in header names and values are now rejected.
Red Discord bot.
copyparty file server.
Sentry.
Package tag is library, but the bug is in the OpenAI-compatible API server. cache_salt from a request is now validated.
Verifying signatures on incoming transactions. The missing finalize_keccak step was added so the check cannot be spoofed.
JSONalyze runs LLM-written SQL on user JSON in a temp SQLite DB. The fix commit mostly moves the module; what changed for the injection is not clear from the diff.
pretix ticketing.
On Windows a git.exe in the current or repo directory ran instead of the real one. CWD is now skipped when resolving the program.
changedetection.io.
Converting text from users; truncated UTF-8 read past the end. Remaining length is now checked. Tests are in ConversionTest.cpp, which the test detector missed.
Splunk and Sumologic callbacks logged task args including no_log secrets. Args are now dropped before sending.
OpenStack Ceilometer.
Tool schemas in chat completion requests could crash the engine. The JSON schema is now validated into a grammar up front.
LangChain integration library. Image inputs can come from users; a local file path was read and sent. Local paths are no longer accepted, only URLs and data URIs.
Jupyter Notebook server.
Multipart parts from requests had no header size or count limit. max_field_size and max_headers are now enforced.

SAML responses posted to the ACS endpoint were accepted without checking the request ID. InResponseTo and errors are now checked. Rechecked under v1.2 tie-break: network changed to end-user via caller.
Same Paddle fix commit as row 153. Op argument shape checks added.
Telnet subnegotiation from a remote peer was buffered without limit. Capped at 4096 bytes, then the connection is dropped.
HTTP client; a server's gzip or deflate body was decompressed without limit. A size cap was added.
Creating an env into a destination with symlinked subdirectories wrote outside it. Directories must now resolve inside the destination.
Downloaded wheels went straight into the reusable cache before verification. Downloads now go to a temp dir and are verified first.
Rendering user HTML fetches its URLs; a redirect could skip the SSRF check. The default fetcher no longer follows redirects.
Khoj.
Roundup issue tracker.
PowerShell scriptblock logging on Windows targets captured module args. The payload is now split from the wrapper so it is not logged.
Flask extension, so a library. CORS path matching used unquote_plus, so + matched differently from routing. Now unquote.
Local executor runs LLM-written code; it could reach forbidden modules through returned objects. Results are now checked against allowed imports.
Parsing untrusted PDFs; get_value recursed without limit. Default max nesting set to 900.
Jupyter Notebook and JupyterHub.
Agent requests tools fetch URLs chosen by the LLM. They are now off unless allow_dangerous_requests is set.
HTTP server; header whitespace handling allowed smuggling, follow-up to an earlier fix. Stricter header checks per the advisory; diff not fetchable so the test field is blank.
Running untrusted JS with disable_pyimport() is the documented use. Diff not fetchable and the advisory does not describe the fix, so fix_type and test are blank.
Apache IoTDB database.
PorterStemmer runs on arbitrary tokens. Quadratic loops on long runs of y and in corpus readers were reworked.
Decoding ASN.1 from other parties; fragment joining was quadratic. Per the advisory; diff not fetchable so the test field is blank.
Crawler validating links scraped from pages. The ReDoS-prone validators URL regex was replaced.
Jupyter server extension.
Tryton ERP server.
Request paths with UNC or drive-relative forms made the server reach out on Windows. Shared unsafe-path checks now reject them.
Reading project files that may come from users. Zip extraction path check now compares canonical paths, not string prefixes.
Bundled libwebp had CVE-2023-4863. Fix is a bundled dependency update.
Reading untrusted PDFs; outline traversal had no bound. Max entries and depth added.
MkDocs plugin.
Verifying signed SAML from other parties; signature wrapping. Documents are now schema-validated before signature checks. Rechecked under v1.2 tie-break: network changed to end-user via caller.
Local cluster workers listened on all interfaces. The host setting is now passed to workers.
MoinMoin wiki.
Scanning untrusted pickle files is the job. More idlelib and stdlib callables added to the blocklist.
Loading model files from others. Lambda and torch wrapper deserialization now fail closed when safe_mode is unset.
Apache StreamPipes.
Parsing tokens from requests; split ran before the size guard. Total size is now checked first.
Linting Compose files from pull requests; their text could become CI workflow commands. Output is now bracketed with stop-commands tokens.
Another local user could create the lock protocol dir first. Ownership and real-directory checks added.
BinderHub.
Decoding untrusted JPEGs with draft scaling overflowed the scanline buffer. Output size is now checked against the buffer.
Loading Arrow IPC or Parquet files from others ran pickle for PyExtensionType. Auto-loading is now off by default.
pygeoapi server.
Infrahub server.
Optical flow on small input images read out of bounds. Patch size and scales are now picked from the image width.
Loading HDF5 model files from others; virtual datasets could read local files. Groups and datasets now go through safe accessors.
WebSocket clients could open unlimited subscriptions. A per-connection limit of 100 was added.
A lower-privileged DB user could create objects that shadow built-in functions. Driver queries now schema-qualify everything with pg_catalog.
parsl-visualize web UI run by the operator. workflow_id from the URL went into SQL; now bound as a parameter.
Wooey.
Downloads from URLs that may come from users; with a proxy, the SSRF pin did not apply. Proxied fetches are refused unless the operator opts in.
Decoding BER from other parties; long OID arcs used unbounded memory. A continuation octet limit was added.
Running untrusted code safely is the job; stack frame attributes allowed escape. Inspect attributes are now blocked.
wger.
Apache Airflow core.
Verifying SNS messages posted to the app's endpoint. The signing cert URL now must match the AWS SNS host pattern.
SMTP server accepted bare LF as end of data, which allowed smuggling. Only CRLF is accepted now.
OpenStack Heat.
Compiler evaluated some arguments in the wrong order. It now refuses to compile risky overlapping expressions.
pretix.
Lemur.
Rendering user Markdown; directive class and width options went into HTML raw. They are now escaped.
OpenStack Mistral.
package_index parses HTML pages from package indexes. The rel attribute regex had unbounded whitespace; now bounded.
Roundup issue tracker.
Sandbox for untrusted code; try/except* hit a CPython type confusion. ExceptionGroup and try/except* are no longer allowed.
DIRAC grid services.
Cipher key derivation had low entropy. Key handling was strengthened in a crypto module rework.
Parsing untrusted Mach-O binaries; thread command state was read past its size. Size checks added.
Cabot.
Reusable Django app with its own accept view; returnTo from the request was not checked. Only safe local redirects are allowed now.
SSO login opened a URL returned by the server through the browser launcher. The URL is now validated first.
Red Discord bot.
OneFuzz service; fix commit has no files.
Rendering user Markdown; predictable toc_N heading IDs could clash with IDs in the content. Auto IDs are now made unique.
Zope app server error page put the error message in HTML raw. It is now escaped.
Source builds pulled a vulnerable setuptools. Fix is a build dependency change.
Secret values were passed as CLI args and leaked in CalledProcessError. They now go through temp files.
Password on the command line was visible. A password file option and env var were added and the flag deprecated, not removed.
MCP server command from the CLI or agent config ran without checks. CLI commands now must be on an allowlist; the SDK class is left open on purpose since developers control it.
Notebook data viewer that serves a web UI; URL uploads allowed SSRF when hosted publicly. Web uploads are now off by default.
Websocket session restore did not check the session's owner. It now must match the connecting user.
The bug is in the project's own CI workflow, not in shipped code; a fork PR's branch name was echoed in a workflow run. The echo step was removed.
Crowdsourcing task config loaded with yaml.load. Now yaml.safe_load.
Malformed multipart POST bodies sent the server parser into a loop. Part headers are now checked on the right object.
Central Dogma server.
Apache Hive.
Apache JSPWiki.
Milvus delete filter built from document IDs without escaping. The linked commit only adds threat-detection docs; the code fix is not in this link.
Rendering untrusted SVG; image elements fetched external URLs. External resource loading is now checked first.
Apache NiFi extension bundle.

Package tag is library, but this is the HTTP connector. Chunk extensions are now parsed strictly, which stops smuggling.

Openfire XMPP server.
Validator processor on message bodies from routes; XSD parsing allowed XXE. Per the advisory; diff not fetchable so the test field is blank.
Tomcat's header number parsing overflowed on long values. An overflow limit was added.
Appsmith server.

OpenAM federation component.
Elasticsearch security plugin; diff not fetchable.
GeoServer and GeoWebCache.
